contracts.authority: Dart SDK archive (storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive): the stable release list, each SDK archive and the .sha256sum beside it; Flutter SDK releases (storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases): the release manifest per host system and the archives it names
contracts.reason: Installs the Dart or Flutter SDK a package's constraint admits when the machine has none: lists the publisher's stable releases, reads the SHA-256 it publishes, and downloads the archive it checks. The formats belong to the Dart and Flutter release processes, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.
